<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

.dgs-llm-page,
.dgs-llm-page *,
.dgs-llm-page *::before,
.dgs-llm-page *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.dgs-llm-page * {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.dgs-llm-page {
  --brand-magenta: #E91E8C;
  --brand-purple: #B91E8C;
  --brand-orange: #FF6B35;
  --gradient-brand: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-magenta) 0%, var(--brand-purple) 50%, var(--brand-orange) 100%);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #000000;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow: hidden;
}


.dgs-container {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 20px;
}


/* Full-width fix for Elementor boxed/720px container issue */
.dgs-llm-page {
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
}

.dgs-container,
.dgs-hero-container,
.dgs-content-wrapper,
.dgs-section-header,
.dgs-final-cta-container,
.dgs-cta-content,
.llm-upgrade .w,
.llm-upgrade .ws {
  max-width: min(1500px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important;
  width: 100%;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper > p,
.dgs-content-wrapper > h2,
.dgs-content-wrapper > h3,
.dgs-content-wrapper > ol,
.dgs-content-wrapper > ul {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.llm-upgrade .sec,
.dgs-content-section,
.dgs-pillars-section,
.dgs-city-section,
.dgs-awards-section,
.dgs-faq-section,
.dgs-cta-section,
.dgs-final-cta,
.dgs-clients {
  width: 100%;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dgs-container,
  .dgs-hero-container,
  .dgs-content-wrapper,
  .dgs-section-header,
  .dgs-final-cta-container,
  .dgs-cta-content,
  .llm-upgrade .w,
  .llm-upgrade .ws {
    max-width: calc(100vw - 32px) !important;
  }
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes gradientPulse {
  0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; filter: brightness(1); }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; filter: brightness(1.3); }
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.7); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 0.8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0); }
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
  33% { transform: translate(40px, -40px) scale(1.15) rotate(5deg); }
  66% { transform: translate(-30px, 30px) scale(0.9) rotate(-5deg); }
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.dgs-gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta));
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  display: inline-block;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite;
}

/* Hero */
.dgs-llm-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 88vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 110px 20px 82px;
}

.dgs-hero-container {
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.dgs-elite-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.15);
  border-radius: 50px;
  padding: 12px 28px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 34px;
  animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.dgs-pulse-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(42px, 7vw, 72px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.16;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.2s backwards;
}

.dgs-hero-description {
  font-size: clamp(18px, 2.3vw, 22px);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  max-width: 930px;
  margin: 0 auto 36px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  animation: fadeInUp 1s ease-out 0.4s backwards;
}

.dgs-updated-line {
  margin: -10px auto 34px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  animation: fadeInUp 1.05s ease-out 0.45s backwards;
}

.dgs-updated-line strong {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dgs-trust-badges {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
  animation: fadeInUp 1.1s ease-out 0.5s backwards;
}

.dgs-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  padding: 8px 18px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 30px;
}

.dgs-trust-item::before {
  content: '';
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.dgs-hero-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 18px;
  animation: fadeInUp 1.2s ease-out 0.6s backwards;
}

.dgs-btn-primary,
.dgs-btn-secondary,
.dgs-btn-whatsapp {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 18px 34px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 17px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

.dgs-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--brand-magenta), var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange), var(--brand-magenta));
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  color: #ffffff;
  animation: gradientPulse 4s ease infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.3);
}

.dgs-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.4);
}

.dgs-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.dgs-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-color: var(--brand-magenta);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(233, 30, 140, 0.2);
}

.dgs-btn-whatsapp {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.dgs-btn-whatsapp:hover {
  background: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.15);
  border-color: #25D366;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.2);
}

.dgs-hero-bg-element {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(140px);
  opacity: 0.15;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-1 {
  width: 600px;
  height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-magenta) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: -150px;
  left: -150px;
  animation: float 25s ease-in-out infinite, gradientPulse 8s ease infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-2 {
  width: 500px;
  height: 500px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-purple) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: 40%;
  right: -150px;
  animation: float 30s ease-in-out infinite 5s, gradientPulse 10s ease infinite;
}

.dgs-hero-bg-3 {
  width: 700px;
  height: 700px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--brand-orange) 0%, transparent 70%);
  bottom: -250px;
  left: 35%;
  animation: float 35s ease-in-out infinite 10s, gradientPulse 12s ease infinite;
}

/* Clients */
.dgs-clients {
  padding: 58px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.dgs-clients-title {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  margin-bottom: 34px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.dgs-clients-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 34px;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-client-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0.72;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

.dgs-client-logo:hover {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.dgs-client-logo img {
  max-width: 132px;
  height: auto;
}



/* Awards Section */
.dgs-awards-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.dgs-awards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-award-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
}

.dgs-award-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  opacity: 0.9;
  z-index: 2;
}

.dgs-award-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-7px);
  border-color: rgba(233,30,140,0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(233,30,140,0.14);
}

.dgs-award-image {
  height: 410px;
  padding: 10px 10px 0;
  background: transparent;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.dgs-award-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
  image-rendering: auto;
}

.dgs-award-body {
  padding: 24px 24px 28px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

.dgs-award-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: rgba(233,30,140,0.09);
  border: 1px solid rgba(233,30,140,0.22);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dgs-award-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dgs-award-desc {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .dgs-awards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dgs-awards-section {
    padding: 70px 20px;
  }

  .dgs-awards-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .dgs-award-image {
    height: 360px;
  }
}
/* Content */
.dgs-content-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
}

.dgs-content-section.alt-bg {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
}

.dgs-content-wrapper {
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper h2 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 50px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper h3 {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 34px);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  margin-top: 44px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper p {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper strong {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper a,
.dgs-inline-link {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper a:hover,
.dgs-inline-link:hover {
  color: #ffffff;
  border-bottom-color: var(--brand-magenta);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(233,30,140,0.35);
}

.dgs-content-wrapper ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 24px 0;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper ul li {
  padding: 10px 0 10px 28px;
  position: relative;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.dgs-content-wrapper ul li:before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 20px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
}


/* Local SEO City Cards */
.dgs-city-section {
  padding: 82px 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.dgs-city-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.dgs-city-card {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 26px 22px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  min-height: 220px;
}

.dgs-city-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--gradient-brand);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.dgs-city-card::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  right: -45px;
  bottom: -55px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(233,30,140,0.16) 0%, transparent 68%);
  filter: blur(8px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;

}

.llm-upgrade .ws {

}

.llm-upgrade .sec {

}

.llm-upgrade .sh {

}

  letter-spacing: .22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
